Name: Floating Garden Pots
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod you can place garden pots in water as you would crab pots. Floating garden pots bob up and down and do not require water.

Garden pots normally must be placed on the farm to allow them to grow produce. You will have to use other mods to remove this restriction if you place them in other locations.



[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
